notes.claim: Pythagoras' theorem can be applied to solve 3-dimensional problems.
Bitesize covers the length of line segments with Pythagoras in 2D, and in 3D at Higher tier.
Finding a hypotenuse means adding the squares of the two shorter sides and taking the square root.

sources.title: Pythagoras' theorem - Pythagoras' theorem - Eduqas - GCSE Maths Revision - Eduqas - BBC Bitesize
sources.quote: Pythagoras' theorem states that, in any right-angled triangle, the square of the hypotenuse is equal to the sum of the squares on the other two sides.
